thread:
Hana: Quick sync — our weekly pulse dashboard is showing a weird dip in launch-post MQLs the same week we had the webinar spike. Looks like ~40% fewer MQLs attributed to launch-posts vs the expected baseline. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/launch-dip.png

Jake: Saw that earlier this morning. My hunch is UTM fallback on the reg form — a bunch of leads landed with campaign=null and ended up as 'direct' in SFDC.

Priya: Ran a quick counts query on the form table — about 260 rows between Mar 15-16 with utm_campaign=NULL. SQL I ran:
```
SELECT utm_campaign, count(*)
FROM registrations
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-15' AND created_at < '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY utm_campaign;
```
Output shows big NULL bucket.

Matt (mktg-ops): @Jake @Hana I'm pulling raw form logs now from the CDN. Note that the routing rule `webinar-override` was tweaked in the release on Mar 14 — possible param parsing change.

analytics-bot: Alert: cohort 'launch-2026' attribution drift +34% vs baseline. Details: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/4723

Hana: Proposal: hold dashboard filters and revert to 'utm_campaign' precedence in attribution logic. Also add a fallback using referrer when campaign is missing, then reprocess last 72h to restore correct counts.

Priya: Agree. Proposed patch (frontend cookie parsing):
```js
// prefer utm_campaign, else parse referrer
const campaign = query.utm_campaign || parseReferrer(document.referrer);
```
I'll open a tiny PR and tag ops.

Jake: If we reprocess leads we need to coordinate with SDRs to avoid duplicate lead reconciliations. @Matt can you notify Sales and pause downstream imports for the reprocess window?

Matt (mktg-ops): On it. I'll ping #sales, put a 30m pause on inbound imports and coordinate with ops. ETA for reprocess window: 45m once patch is deployed.

Hana: For the weekly KPI deck: should I flag this as an "attribution drift" item and include before/after charts? I can slide in the SQL and the reprocess note.

Priya: +1. Add a slide with the SQL snippet, the reprocess timestamp, and call out that there's also a ~12% conversion drop on the webinar landing which may be unrelated and worth monitoring.

Jake: After deploy I'll run the dashboard diff script: `scripts/diff_dashboard.py --window 72h --cohort launch-2026` and post the CSV.

analytics-bot: Deploy job queued: deploy/website#2026 will start in ~12 minutes.

Hana: Cool — let's meet quick at 12:40 ET to confirm the patch and the reprocess. Thanks everyone :pray:

Jake: 👍

Priya: ✅

Matt (mktg-ops): Will post status in #sales and update here once imports are paused.
